Question B-001-019-005.

Why the correct answer is right: All amateur stations must be capable of reliably measuring frequency.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "RF power": RF power is important for limit compliance, but the question asks what every station must reliably measure regardless of mode.
- sourceIndex 2: "SWR": SWR is a useful antenna-system measurement, but it is not the universal measurement capability required of all amateur stations in this item.
- sourceIndex 3: "Modulation": Modulation is relevant for voice quality, but not every emission mode requires modulation measurement as the answer to this item.
